scope: Root-owned task-specific reproducible execution environment; not native engine changes. Actual experiment execution still via ORX immutable commit.

proposal.base: existing local python3.11-slim image pinned by immutable image/digest, not floating at run time
proposal.why: Conservative stable Python3.11-compatible CPU wheels supporting chosen source RF/MAE baseline; no torch/CUDA/model weights needed for first P0. Dependency versions are not scientific hyperparameters.
proposal.execution_limits_to_freeze: network off, read-only runtime root, non-root user, no Docker socket inside training, bound CPU/memory/pids/tmp/output sizes and command deadline
proposal.data_boundary: Docker environment contains no data or credentials; assets mounted separately after membership/custody contract.

installation_authority: User approved installation category and selected P0 real execution; only task-local pinned build, license/security/version/hash checks first. No global/kernel dependencies, no fresh paid provider.
approval_conditions: resolve exact transitive hashes in research-local lock
store build log and image digest
explicit reversible teardown only own env image/cache; preserve receipts
runtime_selection_state: PROPOSED_LOCAL_CPU_EXECUTION_PATH; requires exactP0contract and supportedORXlocal/project setup; no cloud rent
